name: Module 3: capsule wash (real scale, draft)
description: One capsule trap for 10,000 capsules as a single layer, held by a DEPTH WEIR at the waste side (block trap_chamber): the 200 um floor is in plane and z is free, so a 275 um crest, 200 um thick, leaves a 25 um gap under the lid, still one etch depth and one fluidic layer; the 25 um mesh of the original design cannot be printed. The crest height is not quoted from anywhere: it is this chip's 300 um etch depth minus the gap, and it is in the spec as m3_trap_1.retention.crest_height_um. The weir is untested: z tolerance on a gap this small is the biggest unknown, so run a 21 / 24 / 27 um gap coupon first (those span the legal band; 40-80 um gaps would let a 70 um capsule through): load at the top, wash past the retention to waste, back-flush to resuspend, release at the bottom. Build: 20 x 12 mm inside the 30 x 20 mm envelope, ONE fluidic layer at ONE etch depth of 0.3 mm, channels 200 um (floor 200 um), ports 800 um, 4 ports, every chamber and channel a block from contracts/blocks.json. Superseded and kept for reference. CLAMPS: port 500 -> 800 um; chamber height 150 -> 300 um (one etch depth); channel width 140 -> 200 um; mesh 25 um -> depth weir, 25 um gap under the lid.
